title: std::basic_syncbuf<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::~basic_syncbuf
summary: Calls emit() to transmit all pending output (and delayed flush, if any) to the wrapped stream. If an exception is thrown by this call, it is caught and ignored.
html:
~basic_syncbuf();

Calls emit() to transmit all pending output (and delayed flush, if any) to the wrapped stream. If an exception is thrown by this call, it is caught and ignored.

Parameters

(none)

Notes

Normally called by the destructor of the owning std::basic_osyncstream.
